findings.note: 已调整方向 -> 已引导: shipped copy for the same hub steer action is 引导 (fold.receipt.steered 已引导, composer.steer_hint 引导智能体); 方向 also fills the object slot the row appends the child name to. Same for .running 正在调整方向 -> 正在引导.
已查看进展: mass noun 进展 leaves no slot for the row's object (child label / job id). Suggest 已查看 / 正在查看.
已查看会话进展: same object-slot problem with the session id. Suggest 已查看会话记录 / 正在查看会话记录 (glossary: transcript = 记录; distinct from viewed_session 已查看会话).
已将会话移出 drops the 从-relation the sibling keeps (已将会话关联至) and diverges from shipped 解除关联. Suggest 已解除会话关联 / 正在解除会话关联.
已输入至控制台: 输入至 is an odd collocation (至 suits 发送/发布/关联). Suggest 已向控制台输入 / 正在向控制台输入.
已设定定时任务 names a wake as a recurring schedule while the same tool's siblings say 唤醒 and 定时任务 is a separate product page. Suggest 已安排唤醒 / 正在安排唤醒.
已发送消息给 vs shipped 已私信 for the same English Messaged; new wording is clearer for a hub child, no change requested.
已截取控制台: 截屏 is the settled word for a screenshot and is 2 cells shorter. Optional.
